concepts.why: The answer says nothing about blocks, braces or scope.

It correctly gives the purpose of the code as exchanging the first and last elements, which is L3. The L4 attempt in (c) is wrong: the code always uses a[2], so an array of length 1 throws ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException instead of leaving the array unchanged.
The answer says nothing about int or other primitive types.
The answer gives only a bare final array value and does not discuss how variables hold or change values.
